SELECT T1.event_name, T1.location FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T2.remaining > 0
SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name, T2.college FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id WHERE T1.position = 'Secretary'
SELECT SUM(T1.spent), T2.event_name FROM budget AS T1 INNER JOIN event AS T2 ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id WHERE T1.category = 'Speaker Gifts' GROUP BY T2.event_name

SELECT T2.CustomerID FROM yearmonth AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Date) = '2012' AND T2.Segment = 'LAM' GROUP BY T2.CustomerID ORDER BY SUM(T1.Consumption) ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Date) AS Year, SUM(T2.Amount) AS Total_CZK_Consumption FROM yearmonth AS T1 INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID INNER JOIN customers AS T3 ON T2.CustomerID = T3.CustomerID WHERE T3.Currency = 'CZK' GROUP BY STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Date) ORDER BY Total_CZK_Consumption DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.CustomerID = 7 THEN T1.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.CustomerID = 5 THEN T1.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Difference FROM yearmonth AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y%m', T1.Date) = '201304';
SELECT AVG(T1.Price) FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T2.Currency = 'EUR'

SELECT T2.GasStationID, SUM(T1.Amount) AS TotalRevenue FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T2.GasStationID = T1.GasStationID GROUP BY T2.GasStationID ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT T4.Segment FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID INNER JOIN customers AS T4 ON T1.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID WHERE T1.ProductID = 5 AND T1.Price / T1.Amount > 29.00 AND STRFTIME('%Y%m', T2.Date) = '201208'
